title: Build a Few‑Shot Sentiment Classifier
description: From scratch, design a few‑shot prompt to categorize movie reviews into Positive, Negative, or Neutral.
problemStatement:
You want the AI to classify movie reviews into exactly three categories: Positive 😊, Negative 😞, and Neutral 😐, with the emoji. 

Write a single prompt that uses **three few‑shot examples** (one for each category). Make sure:
- The examples are diverse in wording and length.
- Input/Output labels are clear.
- The format is consistent across all examples.

Then, provide a final unlabeled review for the model to classify: "The acting was great but the story dragged on forever." 

After writing the prompt, run it mentally (or in a real tool) and state what output you expect and why.
hints: Make the Positive example very enthusiastic; the Negative one harsh but not vulgar; the Neutral one lukewarm.
Place the final review after a blank line following the examples.
expectedOutput:
A prompt like:

```
Review: "This film was a masterpiece from start to finish!"
Sentiment: 😊 Positive

Review: "I almost walked out of the theater, it was so dull."
Sentiment: 😞 Negative

Review: "It was okay, nothing special."
Sentiment: 😐 Neutral

Review: "The acting was great but the story dragged on forever."
Sentiment:
```
Expected output: 😐 Neutral, because it balances positives and negatives.
